lineage: SPIN (1989-, Bell Labs / JPL, Gerard Holzmann): explicit-state model checker for Promela; on-the-fly LTL verification via nested depth-first search, partial-order reduction, bitstate hashing
version: git tag version-6.5.2, github.com/nimble-code/Spin (the author's repository)
compiler_or_interpreter: gcc + bison (docker debian:bookworm image, see environment/)
dependencies: gcc for the generated verifier pan.c
entry_points: spin -a model.pml -> pan.c; gcc -o pan pan.c; ./pan

example.command: spin -run Examples/... or a Techne smoke model
example.output: verification result: errors: 0 or a counterexample trail

upstream_docs: Holzmann, The SPIN Model Checker: Primer and Reference Manual, 2003

human_capability_summary.built_to: prove that a concurrent protocol or program model satisfies safety and liveness properties, or produce a concrete counterexample execution
human_capability_summary.pressure: state explosion in asynchronous systems; telephony and spacecraft software whose bugs are interleaving-dependent
human_capability_summary.success_means: an exhaustive (or bitstate-approximate) search reporting no errors, or a trail that reproduces a violation

known_human_problem_solved: finding concurrency bugs by exhaustive state-space search

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run spin-6.5.2-holzmann
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: prove that a concurrent protocol or program model satisfies safety and liveness properties, or produce a concrete counterexample execution
